ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area (>90%) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal margins and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs concentrated at the lateral tips; sparse, high-contrast white speckling (mottling) distributed across the dark medial and basal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a deep vertical bounding box relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; visible peaks and valleys ranging from 2-10 pixels in amplitude along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature extending symmetrically from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white clusters on the leading and trailing edges of the distal tips, indicating high-density scarring or calcification.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, parallel, high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the upper-right lobe; secondary shorter linear disruptions visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the right lobe surface and dense irregular scarring/texture on both distal tips.
